chapter: Chicago and Oliver's band in California
title: Describing a band's style and players
summary: Asked if a band played hot, he lists Slocum on clarinet, J. Wells on alto and flute, Roy on trombone and a cripple drummer.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, but would it sound like Rubishow's band or Horry's band?
No, they had a pretty good band, such as Prada.
Would he play Stocks or was it Get Off or what?
Yeah, they played, you know, they played, yeah, yeah, sure they did.
Stocks? Did they have anybody in the band that Get Off?
Oh yeah. Yeah, they played Slocum on the Clionet.
J. Wells on alto sax and the flute.

And Roy played trombone, baritone. Little cripple fella played the drums in the zilliforms. There was one boy, there was one time they got to old Fox. I can't call this little drummer his name. I never did know him.
But he was out in San Francisco.
